card.name: Middle of 'angina' and 'gin' words
card.fires_on: The piece 'inal' completing 'anginal' (e.g. 'Antianginal') in drug-interaction lists. It also fires on 'gin' pieces such as 'cotton gin', 'Ginsberg' and 'BENIGN'.

modes.label: Anginal
modes.description: The 'inal' ending of 'anginal' or 'antianginal' in drug-class lists or chest-pain text.

modes.label: Gin or -ign spellings
modes.description: The 'gin', 'Gin' or 'IGN' piece in words like cotton gin, Ginsberg and BENIGN.
